# Cloud Apikey Get

Get a specific API key by id

## Prerequisites

- Authenticated with `agentuity auth login`

## Usage

```bash
agentuity cloud apikey get <id>
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `<id>` | string | Yes | - |

## Examples

Get item details:

```bash
bunx @agentuity/cli cloud apikey get <id>
```
